# schedulingSoftware

Scheduling and resource-allocation tool for a growing US M&A Tax advisory team: pipeline intake → effort estimation (hours by level) → time-phased staffing → weekly capacity visibility, with a NetSuite actuals feedback loop.

**Current status:** Excel-first delivery (web app deferred). The tracker is built as a structured workbook generated by `scripts/build_workbook.py` from the July 9 source file.

See **[PLAN.md](PLAN.md)** for the workbook spec and the step-by-step delivery roadmap — each step is sized for one Claude Code session with a recommended model (Opus vs Sonnet), inputs, and acceptance criteria.
